meta.title: Guitar Tuner — Free guitar tuner app
meta.description: Free guitar tuner for Android and iOS. Real-time pitch detection with the YIN algorithm.

hero.title: The guitar tuner that fits in your pocket
hero.sub: Pitch detection with the YIN algorithm in pure TypeScript. Works offline, no ads, no subscription.

features.label: Features
features.title: Everything you need to tune
features.yinDesc: Pitch detection with the YIN algorithm in pure TypeScript. Threshold 0.10, Hann window, parabolic interpolation for maximum accuracy.
features.latencyDesc: Float32Array ring buffer with copyWithin. 50% overlap and UI updates at 30 Hz.
features.otaDesc: Updates via EAS Update without publishing a new store release. development, preview, and production channels.
features.stringsDesc: E2 · A2 · D3 · G3 · B3 · E4. Interactive grid highlighting the string closest to the detected frequency.
features.needleDesc: Visual cents indicator with native spring animation. Color feedback for flat, in tune, and sharp in real time.
features.gateDesc: RMS gate to ignore ambient noise. Simple EMA (α=0.25) smooths readings without masking transients.

download.label: Download
download.title: Install for free
download.tagline: No ads. No subscription. Open source.
download.androidBody: Download the APK directly without the Play Store. Enable “Install unknown apps” or “Unknown sources” in Android settings.
download.iosBody: iOS distribution requires an Apple Developer account. For now, clone the repository and build locally with Xcode or EAS.
download.iosMeta: Requires Apple Developer Program for distribution

tech.label: Technology
tech.title: Open source end to end
tech.body: Built with React Native + Expo, with no external DSP dependencies. All audio processing runs in pure TypeScript on the JS thread.
